title: ipomoea minuta f. adiantifolia
intro: Ipomoea minuta f. adiantifolia, commonly known as the 'small morning glory', is a climbing plant native to tropical regions. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea minuta f. adiantifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and lower body temperature. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
